categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Has the Build system label and modifies depends/funcs.mk to adjust depends package archive naming.
categories.rationale: Prevents depends from silently building from the wrong source tree when multiple checkouts share a SOURCES_PATH. As noted in the PR description, colliding tarball filenames mean a build can reuse an archive from another worktree such that 'that directory silently builds from the wrong sources: the checksum and build ID are calculated correctly, but for the wrong content.'
